tasks.subject: Task 2: Payload restriction well-formedness check
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Reject Promise/Chan whose payload is function-typed or effectful; allow first-order data and bare type vars.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Error.hs", "src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/conc-payload-fn.wok", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/conc-payload-effectful.wok"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test 2>&1 | grep conc-payload", "acceptanceCriteria": ["function/effectful payload rejected with span", "first-order data accepted", "bare type var allowed"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: PRDrive hook + box/unbox prims + Sched stub
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Box/unbox (runtime identity) + PRDrive machine hook compile and wire runConc to a stub driveConc.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/Value.hs", "src/Wok/Interp/Prim.hs", "src/Wok/Interp/Sched.hs", "src/Wok/Interp/Machine.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal build && cabal test 2>&1 | tail -3", "acceptanceCriteria": ["PRDrive Value added", "__box/__unbox identity", "__drive_conc -> PRDrive dispatched", "builds green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: driveConc core -- yield + spawn + drain (SPIKE)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Deterministic scheduler driving root + fire-and-forget children, interleaving at yield, draining all. Validates the transport encoding.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/Sched.hs", "test/run-examples/conc-spawn-order.wok", "test/run-golden/conc-spawn-order.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test 2>&1 | grep conc-spawn-order", "acceptanceCriteria": ["spawn+yield interleave deterministically", "round-robin FIFO", "children drain fire-and-forget"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: async / await / Promise cells
tasks.description:
**Goal:** async fills a generational promise cell; await parks/resumes; await-many/fulfil-once cached; deadlock errors not hangs.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/Sched.hs", "test/run-examples/conc-async-await.wok", "test/run-golden/conc-async-await.expected", "test/run-examples/conc-await-many.wok", "test/run-golden/conc-await-many.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test 2>&1 | grep -E 'conc-async-await|conc-await-many'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["await returns producer result via cell", "park then resume FIFO", "second await cached", "deadlock -> RuntimeError"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Chan / send / recv
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Channels: newChan allocates; send enqueues/wakes oldest receiver; recv returns next or parks. Observable-interleave primitive.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/Sched.hs", "test/run-examples/conc-chan-order.wok", "test/run-golden/conc-chan-order.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test 2>&1 | grep conc-chan-order", "acceptanceCriteria": ["send/recv FIFO", "recv parks on empty, send wakes oldest", "deterministic interleave golden"]}
```

tasks.description:
**Goal:** End-to-end library combinators; raceAny returns first-to-fulfil, losers dropped without error.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["prelude/Std/Control.wok", "test/run-examples/conc-parall.wok", "test/run-golden/conc-parall.expected", "test/run-examples/conc-raceany.wok", "test/run-golden/conc-raceany.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test 2>&1 | grep -E 'conc-parall|conc-raceany'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["parAll results in spawn order", "raceAny returns fast, losers dropped", "function payload rejected"]}
```
